reference_origin: shared accepted detailed reference; no separate business authoring attempt

oracle_runtime.algorithm: Independent civil datetime parsing, complete-month eligibility, per-user sets of valid event types in [signup,next-month), full eligible registry iteration and monthly activated/users; no Loginom outputs used.

dataset_origin.author: eval author
dataset_origin.description: Seven users and eighteen raw action events, frozen before gold under the approved P18/G03 fixture plan. Event physical order is deliberately nonchronological; no derived flags or aggregates in runtime inputs.
dataset_origin.time_basis: one naive civil calendar, fixed ISO seconds without offset/Z/fractions; no UTC attribution or timezone conversion
dataset_origin.limitations: Only create_project/invite_member/export, complete user registry and valid event foreign keys, no NULL inputs. Not real product telemetry.

publication_note: Local machine paths, instance addresses and session/storage identifiers are omitted. Verification statements describe the original run; private evidence is not included. Public datasets, versions and content hashes are retained.
